name: Fitchburg Finches
blurb: They sprint at the opening whistle and dare you to survive the first two possessions.

intents.name: ALL-IN PRESS
intents.text: They are overcommitting. CONTROL directly cuts their score this possession.

intents.name: BLUDGER RUSH
intents.text: They want chaos. STYLE makes their pressure predictable.

tacticalProfile.boardTip: Expect early Beater pressure. Contest it or attack the empty Chaser side.

name: Appleby Arrows
blurb: Quiet early. Horrifying late. Their Seeker pressure compounds if you leave it alone.

intents.name: SEEKER WINDOW
intents.text: They are hunting the Snitch. SNITCH PRESSURE contests the lane.

intents.name: PATIENT BUILD
intents.text: They are scaling. FAN PRESSURE disrupts the quiet setup.

tacticalProfile.boardTip: Their Seeker lane gets more dangerous every possession. Decide when to answer it.

name: Morytania Manticores
blurb: They weaponise bad conditions. Weather-proof chains are worth planning around.

intents.name: WEATHER TRAP
intents.text: They are leaning into the conditions. Playing 3+ different roles breaks the trap.

intents.name: FOG SCREEN
intents.text: Their shape is hard to read. CONTROL exposes it.

tacticalProfile.boardTip: They lean into weather-favoured lanes. Read the conditions before committing.

name: Keldagrim Keepers
blurb: Defensive possessions become huge scoring counters. Style and Snitch pressure crack them open.

intents.name: KEEPER WALL
intents.text: Straight attacks feed their defence. STYLE or SNITCH pressure bypasses it.

intents.name: COUNTER FORMATION
intents.text: They are waiting for an obvious all-in. Filling every tactical slot feeds the counter; a smaller varied shape is safer.

tacticalProfile.boardTip: The centre is their fortress. Flank it, or bring enough Control to crack it.

name: Karamja Krakens
blurb: They copy explosive turns. Small efficient chains are safer than one obvious all-in.

intents.name: MOMENTUM MIRROR
intents.text: They copy your Momentum. CONTROL and STYLE score without feeding the mirror.

intents.name: KRAKEN SWARM
intents.text: They flood the lanes. BEATER pressure gives you room.

tacticalProfile.boardTip: Wide pressure creates openings for Momentum theft. Bank Momentum only when you can protect it.

name: Repo All-Stars
blurb: They watch what you built all season and lean into the stat you neglected.

intents.name: THEY READ THE TAPE
intents.text: They target your lowest contribution. A balanced possession is the best answer.

intents.name: PRIME-TIME PRESSURE
intents.text: The final is loud. FAN PRESSURE and STYLE turn the crowd back in your favour.

tacticalProfile.boardTip: They adapt to the lane that carried your previous possession. Do not become predictable.
